svg.aria-label: Nicotine, page 2 of 2. Contraindication Immediate post-myocardial infarction period, severe or worsening angina pectoris, severe cardiac arrhythmias, and active temporal/jaw TMJ disorders (for gum). Adverse reaction Tachycardia, hypertension, cardiac arrhythmias, and acute nicotine toxicity (seizures, respiratory failure). Side effects Local skin irritation (patch), mouth irritation or hiccups (gum/lozenge), insomnia, headache, dizziness, nausea, and vivid dreams. Special notes Advise patients to completely stop smoking while using any nicotine replacement product to avoid dangerous cardiovascular spikes.
